missing_hlg_evaluation.rationale: Voting result 3/3 for NO_MISSING_HIGH_LEVEL_GOALS. The project description outlines responsibilities for Suppliers, Administrators, Warehouse Staff, Customers, Customer Support Agents, Managers, and Store Clerks. All explicit functional requirements are covered by the current High-Level Goals. Specifically, the Store Clerk's responsibilities ('Assists customers with in-store purchases, processes payments, and handles immediate sales') are fully entailed by the current HLG 'Process End-to-End In-Store Customer Purchases', which explicitly includes 'processing the sale and handling various payment methods'. The separate HLG 'Accurately handle in-store payments' is redundant but does not indicate a missing goal. All other actors' responsibilities (proposal management, system configuration, inventory management, online purchasing, delivery tracking, support ticketing, and business analysis) are also adequately covered by their respective current HLGs. No new actor-level outcomes are identified in the description that are not already represented.
